mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(t1.cnt, 0) AS todayOrderCount, COALESCE(t1.rev, 0) AS todayRevenue, COALESCE(t1.avg, 0) AS todayAvgOrderAmount, COALESCE(t1.ref, 0) AS todayRefundAmount, COALESCE(t2.cnt, 0) AS weekOrderCount, COALESCE(t2.rev, 0) AS weekRevenue, COALESCE(t3.cnt, 0) AS monthOrderCount, COALESCE(t3.rev, 0) AS monthRevenue, COALESCE(t4.cnt, 0) AS totalOrders, COALESCE(t4.rev, 0) AS totalRevenue FROM (SELECT 1) dummy LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pay_status = '1' THEN pay_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS rev, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pay_status = '1' THEN pay_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) / COUNT(*) ELSE 0 END AS avg, COALESCE(SUM(refund_amount), 0) AS ref FROM share_order.order_info WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() AND del_flag = '0' ) t1 ON 1=1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pay_status = '1' THEN pay_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS rev FROM share_order.order_info WHERE YEARWEEK(create_time, 1) = YEARWEEK(CURDATE(), 1) AND del_flag = '0' ) t2 ON 1=1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pay_status = '1' THEN pay_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS rev FROM share_order.order_info WHERE DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m') AND del_flag = '0' ) t3 ON 1=1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pay_status = '1' THEN pay_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS rev FROM share_order.order_info WHERE del_flag = '0' ) t4 ON 1=1

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pay_status = '1' THEN pay_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS revenue FROM share_order.order_info WHERE del_flag = '0' AND create_time >= #{startDate} AND create_time <= CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59') GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date

SELECT pay_way AS payWay, CASE pay_way WHEN 0 THEN '微信支付' ELSE CONCAT('支付方式(', pay_way, ')') END AS payWayName, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS amount FROM share_payment.payment_info WHERE del_flag = '0' AND payment_status = 1 /* 支付成功 */
AND create_time >= #{startDate}
AND create_time <= CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59')
GROUP BY pay_way ORDER BY amount DESC
